objective: Establish Caelen's self-serving Marine persona through routine and ambition, then depict his fatal choice to shield a noncombatant mother from Sergeant Miller's gunfire, resulting in his death.
intendedChange: Caelen transitions from a status-seeking Marine exploiting his squad to a dead man who has instinctively chosen to protect a vulnerable stranger, breaking his pattern of self-preservation.
prohibitedPatterns: Do not depict Caelen's death-time choice, Creator visit, or void experience.

beats.purpose: Establish Caelen's defensive pride and selfish ambition by depicting him taking credit for Private Davis's tactical call during a debrief, while internally resenting Sergeant Miller's rigid adherence to protocol.
beats.intendedChange: Caelen secures a verbal commendation from Miller, reinforcing his belief that he can manipulate the hierarchy for personal gain, while Davis is left silent and marginalized.

beats.purpose: Introduce the tactical complication of a noncombatant mother carrying a dead infant in the kill zone, forcing Caelen to view her as a liability that threatens his mission and status.
beats.intendedChange: Caelen identifies the mother as an obstacle to the squad's objective, preparing the ground for the conflict between his self-interest and his residual humanity.

beats.purpose: Depict the inciting incident where Sergeant Miller orders the engagement of the mother, prompting Caelen to make a sudden, uncalculated choice to shield her with his body, resulting in his death from gunshot wounds.
beats.intendedChange: Caelen is killed by Miller's gunfire while protecting the mother, who survives, completing the inciting incident and ending his Earth life.
